summary.text: William Infantine is a Republican candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Hillsborough 39, in the November 3, 2026 general election, and a former state representative who owns an insurance agency.

paragraphs.text: Infantine, who is also known as Will, graduated from Milford Area Senior High School in 1982 and earned a B.S. in business administration from St. Michael's College in 1986.
His career experience includes owning and co-founding Aspen Insurance Agency.

Ballotpedia lists Infantine as a member of the New Hampshire House from 2002 to 2016 and again from 2020 to 2024, and as chair of the Labor, Industrial and Rehabilitative Services Committee in the 2015 and 2021-2024 sessions.
He won election in Hillsborough 13 in 2020 and in Hillsborough 16 in 2022, and lost the Hillsborough 16 general election in 2024.
He advanced from the September 8, 2026 Republican primary for Hillsborough 39.
